tagline: Hakos Baelz's Mirror Mirror dropped this morning and REGALIA general sale opened yesterday with TeddyLoid on stage. Phase Connect spent the week arguing with YouTube about how old Mari Mari is. ROF-MAO turned five with three members and handwritten notes from a hiatus.
inThisIssue: Mirror Mirror is out — Hakos Baelz's 8-track second album available today; REGALIA general tickets on sale at Kanadevia Hall December 1; TeddyLoid confirmed on stage
Phase Connect Mari Mari banned from YouTube for suspected underage livestreaming — moved to Twitch; Phase Connect appealed; ban reversed
NIJISANJI EN at Anime Festival Asia Singapore: Sonny Brisko, Shu Yamino, Luca Kaneshiro, and Ren Zotto performing November 28 at Suntec City

lead.title: Hakos Baelz's second album Mirror Mirror is out today — 8 self-written tracks, LP-sized double jacket; REGALIA general sale opened yesterday with TeddyLoid confirmed as guest; concert December 1 at Kanadevia Hall
lead.body: Hakos Baelz's second studio album Mirror Mirror released today, November 2, 2026, on Cover Corp. The album runs 8 tracks including SNAKE EYES and I found me, and is themed around reflection — Baelz wrote the majority of its songs herself. The physical CD is priced at 12,100 yen in an LP-sized double jacket and comes with a special message letter with reproduction print and handwritten signature, an original mirror sticker, and an artbook-style lyric card, plus a bonus voice track reading the letter in Japanese and English. General ticket sales for REGALIA, her first solo concert at Kanadevia Hall on December 1, opened November 1 at 1 PM JST via ZAIKO. TeddyLoid was confirmed simultaneously as a guest performer — the first named addition to a show announced at her fifth anniversary stream in August alongside the album. Kanadevia Hall holds approximately 1,900 in its main configuration; this is her largest solo venue booking. The first ticket lottery ran in October, the second on October 26; general sales as of yesterday put venue tickets in direct purchase rather than lottery. Digital streaming is available on ZAIKO and SPWN with archive access through January 8, 2027. Mirror Mirror is the first hololive English member second album to land in November. It is today.

stories.title: Phase Connect Mari Mari banned from YouTube livestreaming — YouTube flagged her as under 16; she moved to Twitch, Phase Connect appealed, ban reversed
stories.blurb: Phase Connect's Mari Mari announced in late October that YouTube had banned her from livestreaming after the platform's combination of automated systems and human reviews determined she was under the age of 16. YouTube's policy requires minors below 16 to be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian to stream. She stated Phase Connect was actively working to correct the determination and moved all live streaming to Twitch in the interim. A fan account noted that H2oSakana had publicly volunteered to serve as her parent or legal guardian, generating its own thread. Phase Connect filed a correction with YouTube, and the ban was subsequently reversed. The incident is the first widely reported YouTube age-misclassification ban involving a Phase Connect talent and follows the agency's busy October running through the Phase Saga anniversary.

stories.title: NIJISANJI EN confirmed for Anime Festival Asia Singapore 2026 — Sonny Brisko, Shu Yamino, Luca Kaneshiro, Ren Zotto perform remotely November 28 at 17:15 SGT at Suntec City
stories.blurb: ANYCOLOR announced on October 19 that NIJISANJI EN will participate in Anime Festival Asia Singapore 2026, running November 27-29 at Suntec City Convention and Exhibition Centre, Hall 401-406. Four Livers perform remotely on the AFA NEXT Stage on November 28 at 17:15 SGT: Sonny Brisko, Shu Yamino, Luca Kaneshiro, and Ren Zotto. Admission is included with general event entry; no separate stage ticket is required. The performance will not be streamed. A NIJISANJI booth will distribute special perk items to attendees. AFA Singapore is one of Southeast Asia's largest anime conventions and the NIJISANJI EN appearance places the agency at the same venue weekend as hololive Meet's European debut at DreamHack Stockholm, making November 27-29 the densest single international event window for VTuber fandom in Q4.

stories.title: NIJISANJI x Kura Sushi Part 3 launches October 30 — three collab menu items with stickers, Bikkura Pon limited goods, A3 poster with 2,500 yen spend; runs through November 26
stories.blurb: The third NIJISANJI x Kura Sushi collaboration launched at participating locations nationwide on October 30. The campaign runs through November 26 and features three collab menu items, each with a collectible sticker. Limited-edition merchandise is available through the Bikkura Pon capsule system. Customers who spend 2,500 yen or more in a single visit receive an A3 poster as a giveaway while supplies last. The first campaign ran in May 2025 and the third round maintains the same nationwide participating-location model. Part 3 overlaps with the NIJISANJI EN AFA Singapore appearance, keeping NIJISANJI visible across both event and collab channels through November. Participating livers and location details are at collabo-cafe.com.

stories.title: ROF-MAO reaches five years — handwritten messages from Kagami Hayato, Fuwa Minato, and Kaida Haru posted from hiatus; fan message campaign open through November 14; return unannounced
stories.blurb: ROF-MAO reached its fifth anniversary on October 21. The unit's official account posted handwritten anniversary messages from its three remaining members: Kagami Hayato, Fuwa Minato, and Kaida Haru, who have been in group activity hiatus since Kenmochi Toya completed his unit activities on May 28, 2026. A fan message campaign celebrating the fifth anniversary is running through November 14. ROF-MAO is the first NIJISANJI unit to reach a five-year mark while simultaneously in a post-departure hiatus. All three members have continued individual activities through the break. No return announcement has been made and ANYCOLOR has posted nothing specific to that effect, though community speculation about the November 14 campaign deadline as a coordination window for a return is active in NIJISANJI fan spaces.

stories.title: Streamer Awards 2026 Best VTuber voting closed October 31 — result sealed until the November 12 ceremony in Los Angeles; no live vote count was visible to voters
stories.blurb: Best VTuber voting at the 2026 Streamer Awards closed at midnight on October 31. The five nominees — TheBurntPeanut, Ironmouse, Koseki Bijou, Crelly, and Gigi Murin — remain live on the official site, but no vote totals were displayed to voters at any point during the window. The result will not be known outside the organizing team until the live ceremony on November 12 in Los Angeles. QTCinderella hosts; red carpet at 2:30 PM PT, main show at 5:30 PM PT. The voting window opened October 16 following the nominees announcement and ran fifteen days. TheBurntPeanut won the same category at the 2025 awards. The 2025 outcome generated community debate that continued into nomination discussion this year and will continue, in a different register, from November 12 onward.

indieSubhead: NO AGENCY, NO PROBLEM — NEWS FROM THE SELF-MADE CORNER OF THE SCENE

indies.title: CapoCoda debuts October 29 — closes the October indie cohort; November schedule opens with debuts on November 3, 11, 16, and 21
indies.blurb: CapoCoda completed the October independent debut class on October 29, closing a cohort that opened with Ome Teoru and Nibbelle on October 10-11 and Namirisu on October 26. November opens its own debut calendar immediately: hololist.net currently lists debuts on November 3, November 11 including CrazyTama and Lucieliya, November 16 with Cassian Aetheria, and November 21 with Leannleo. The Streamer Awards ceremony on November 12 is the largest viewer-attention event in the first half of November; debuts on November 11-13 launch into high ambient traffic. Debut tracking at hololist.net.

indies.title: Independent VTuber Miso graduates November 1 — final stream and project release mark the end of an 18-month run; approximately 33,000 YouTube subscribers
indies.blurb: Independent VTuber Miso (misoyans) graduated on November 1 with a final stream and a project release. She debuted in May 2025 and reached approximately 33,000 YouTube subscribers over 18 months. Her statement cited goals she wants to pursue outside content creation, describing the decision as the result of extended reflection. Miso is the most prominent indie departure of the November 1 week and lands in the same window as CapoCoda's October 29 debut — the Q4 indie calendar running debuts and graduations in parallel, as it does every October into November. Her project release and stream archive were available at the time of the final stream.

tea.text: The /vt/ Phase Connect thread discovered the H2oSakana parent-guardian volunteer offer within seventeen minutes of the DiscussingPhase tweet. The thread did not debate whether it was a genuine offer. It did not check whether H2oSakana has legal standing to act as a guardian for a Phase Connect talent. It immediately began planning what streams would look like with a guardian present, whether the guardian would be required to share a greenscreen, and whether this would make H2oSakana an official Phase Connect employee. By hour two someone had created a tier list ranking Phase Connect livers by likelihood of being assessed as under 16 by YouTube's combined automated systems and human reviews. Mari's reversal post arrived. The thread read the reversal as incomplete information. The tier list is still up.

The Streamer Awards Best VTuber voting closed at midnight October 31. The /vt/ thread spent the final three minutes running a per-minute update chain on whether the system was still accepting votes. Nobody in the thread could confirm whether the system was still accepting votes because nobody could see the vote count. At 12:01 AM a post said it is done, we cannot change it now. This is the most-upvoted post in the thread. The ceremony is November 12. The thread has eleven days to run with nothing to show for it. The first prediction post appeared at 12:04 AM. It predicted all five nominees would win simultaneously and offered this as a defensible outcome under certain interpretations of the category criteria. The thread gave it one upvote. One upvote was described in the replies as exactly the right amount.

The ROF-MAO five-year anniversary thread organized into three channels within the first hour. Channel one: people reading Kagami Hayato's handwritten message and live-updating whether they could parse the kanji correctly, with a rolling accuracy score. Channel two: the November 14 fan campaign deadline theory, which holds that the closing date is the unit communicating a return window without making an announcement, and which the thread is treating as a probability estimate rather than a prediction. Channel three: the Kenmochi Toya departure announcement from May, posted without commentary by a rotating set of accounts, each new instance generating a reply asking them to stop and a counter-reply asking what stopping would accomplish. The handwriting accuracy rate is currently at 73%. November 14 is twelve days away. The third channel has not stopped.

The Shattered Legends premiere-date prediction thread is on its fourth methodology. The first was vibe-based and eliminated every Tuesday and most Thursdays. The second was derived from Critical Role's historical upload schedule and was discarded when someone noted this is a hololive collab and hololive does not use Critical Role's upload schedule. The third involved counting the letters in cast member names, produced November 17 as the answer, and was voted correct by the thread 3-to-1 on mathematical grounds. The mathematical-grounds ruling is still contested. The fourth methodology is someone stating I think it is November 13. The thread is monitoring this. The official announcement still says mid-November. The thread accepts this as a data point.

footerNote: Next signal drops Monday, 9 November — two days before the Streamer Awards ceremony in LA, three days before Suisei closes the tour in Fukuoka, and somewhere in that window Shattered Legends goes live. Mirror Mirror is out. The week is already moving. See you in seven.
